Arguitur Pontifi c.Rom.infolentia,qui Petri fucceffione, fuperbi,quiduis pro li- bidine faciūt.Vide dift.40.Ca.Si Papa.At quod hic fit,etiam alibi, Gal.2. Sic Victor reprehenfus ab Irenæo, &c. fed fic oportet Antichriftum agere,Dan.7.2.Theff.2.
